steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Hero Abilities
steps.body:
Your heroes have more than just a basic attack. Each class comes with special abilities that activate on cooldown — you'll see them light up in the combat panel.

Abilities are more powerful than basic attacks but can't be used every turn. Watch the cooldown counter to time them right.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Growth & Passives
steps.body:
As heroes level up, they unlock stronger abilities and passive bonuses. Higher-level heroes hit harder and survive longer.

Tier 4 equipment is special — each piece carries a passive combat effect tied to its region. These trigger automatically in battle: healing at the start of each round, burning enemies on attack, buffing defense when low on health, and more. Check equipment tooltips to see what each T4 item does.
